edits.text: - Place types: use the most specific type from the name. A name ending in 省 is `province`; Taiwan, Hong Kong and mainland China (中国大陆) are `country-region`. A road/street inside a city is linked with :place, and so is a studio inside a building or city (not :part-of). Subsidiaries and a channel belonging to an organization are :part-of that organization. Keep 《》 title marks as the first and last name tokens. Do not put generic suffixes such as 公司 in a company name.

edits.anchor: Words with no PropBank frame (e.g. 启播, 回放) get sense -00, not -01.
edits.text: Words with no PropBank frame (e.g. 启播, 自制, 告吹, 调往, 无意, 播出) get sense -01, never -00. Keep the whole verb word as written (改为, 迁至, 购入, 购自, 设有), not a truncated stem. The only exception is 批予, which is split into 批 + 予.

edits.anchor: (台 and 该台 stay as they are, never 电视台 + :mod 该;

edits.text: - Split a demonstrative from its noun: 该台 is 台 with :mod 该 (never 电视台, and never one fused concept). Do not collapse a multi-word NP into one concept.

edits.anchor: aspect state, never 是-01 with ARG0/ARG1.
edits.text: never 是-01 with ARG0/ARG1. Only a main-clause identity-91 gets :aspect state and modal relations; appositive, embedded, have-degree and title-description identity-91 get no aspect, modal or temporal relation. In a title/description identity-91 the named entity is ARG1 and the description ARG2.

edits.anchor: scope adjectives like 地区性/全国性 are :place
edits.text: scope adjectives like 地区性/全国性 are :mod, while 本地 (local) is :place; the language of content is :medium; a signal or transmission means (讯号, system) is :medium, not :instrument; the origin of a purchase (海外) is :source

edits.anchor: habitual only for clearly recurring broadcasts
edits.text: habitual for generic, characteristic or recurring activities of an institution (播放, 广播, 服务, 制作, 购入, 接收), including coordinated ones; a bounded or completed event, and purpose or modifier events in a realized setting, is performance (not process); 增加 or 覆盖 trends and ongoing coverage are state; the phasal event 开始 is performance

edits.anchor: Adversative 但/然而 is `but-91` with :ARG1/:ARG2 (not and/:opN).
edits.text: Adversative 但 (clause-medial) is `but-91` with :ARG1 the whole preceding coordination and :ARG2 the contrasted clause; a sentence-initial 然而 is not a concept, so the clause relation (e.g. have-reason-91) is the root.

- Clauses that are comma- or semicolon-separated and share a subject are a flat top-level `and` (op1..opN), one per clause, none omitted. The shared subject is a re-entrant :ARG0 on later predicates, never :ARG0-of on the first node. A verb that modifies a noun (V 的 N, participial 购自 X, 播放 on X) hangs on that noun by :ARG0-of/:ARG1-of rather than becoming a clause head. Aspectual verbs (开始, 继续) are full events (-01) with the main event as :ARG1 and carry the subject and clause adverbials. 斥资 + amount is an event (ARG1 the acquisition, ARG2 the money). 来自 and 包括 are ordinary predicates (包括-01, not include-91). Every event, including modifier and aspectual events, gets modal and temporal relations.

- Coreference links connect entity concept nodes (company, channel, city, province, 当局 and CRTC), never name nodes. Chain every repeated mention (including 该台, 当局, a 频道 or 卑诗省 in later sentences) to the earlier mention within one chain. A pronoun in the same sentence reuses the node. Do not link 牌照 with a company, and give nominals that are not events (申请, 计划) no same-event link.

suggestions: Provide a few full worked examples of top-level 'and' coordination with a shared subject and of 开始/继续 phasal structures, since structural errors cascade into aspect, modal, temporal and coref mismatches.
Make the coreference step operate over concept nodes only, with a checklist of recurring entities (company, channel, city, province, authority) to chain at the end of the document.
